decisions.reason: A spring-controlled flap weir is a low-cost extension of the firm's core hydraulic steel engineering business, its market value is still uncertain after only one year, and keeping it open costs little.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic push toward digital networking and energy recovery, so this growth option is worth holding while municipal demand becomes clearer, even though software options like the fouling tools have been dropped before.
The overflow flap gate already has a dedicated page, sits in the firm's core flood-control portfolio, and is cheap to keep, so abandoning it would be premature.
